instructions:
Move clamp() from utils.js into main.js using windows:
1. :vs utils.js and cut the function there with dap.
2. In its place type: // moved to main.js
3. Ctrl-w w to the main.js window, then ggP to paste it at the top.
4. :sp README.md and add a last line: - clamp() now lives in main.js
5. Ctrl-w c to close the README window, then :wa
solution: :vs utils.js<CR>dapi// moved to main.js<Esc><C-w>wggP:sp README.md<CR>Go- clamp() now lives in main.js<Esc><C-w>c:wa<CR>
